subject.title: Agents: default nodes describe to current node

question: Should omitted-node agent-tool `nodes` `describe` resolve the current/default node, return list-style discovery output, or remain explicit-node-only with a clearer schema/prompt contract?
rationale: The current PR chooses implicit default-node selection, while the linked issue discussion and CLI/docs leave room for list-style discovery or explicit-node semantics; multi-node behavior is a product contract, not a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Confirm default-node describe
options.body: Accept the PR direction, require proof and a focused regression test, and document that omitted-node `describe` targets the selected default node.

options.title: Use list-style discovery
options.body: Replace this patch with no-node `describe` returning list/status-like discovery data while explicit-node `describe` keeps calling `node.describe`.

options.title: Keep explicit-node describe
options.body: Close or revise the PR in favor of clearer tool guidance/schema behavior that sends discovery callers to `status` before `describe`.

recommendation.title: Confirm default-node describe
recommendation.body: Accept the PR direction, require proof and a focused regression test, and document that omitted-node `describe` targets the selected default node.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger introduced and heavily maintained the affected agent tool/schema surface, so he is the best available owner for the behavior contract choice.
